title: Chintamani Library v2.7.3 — Universal Portal Registration Fix, Premium Claymorphism Directory & Live Polling Alerts
releaseNotes: FIXED UNIVERSAL PORTAL REGISTRATION: Resolved 'Selected plan not found' root cause with dynamic database plan fetching and multi-tier plan resolver across Mehdawal and Khalilabad
STRICT BRANCH ISOLATION: Member admission, seat reservation, fee calculation, and payment transactions strictly scoped to the user-selected branch
SAFE DATE OF BIRTH: Implemented timezone-safe local date parsing across backend and portal, eliminating day-shift errors and rejecting future birth dates
PREMIUM CLAYMORPHISM SUMMARY CARDS: Redesigned Members Directory status cards with compact 90px dimensions, subtle tactile depth, muted luxury palette, and zero white highlight dots

FOREGROUND & RESUME PUSH POLLING: 20-second active foreground polling and instant lifecycle-resume synchronization for incoming registrations, payments, and complaints with native heads-up system tray alerts
INSTANT OTA UPDATE: Automatic in-app update trigger delivered seamlessly without manual APK download
